verify-before-use.why: The panel only sees a build that passed the verify gate

qa-before-use.why: QA verifies the build before the customer round, not alongside it

verify-before-publish.why: Only an exact verified commit is published

verify-before-merge.why: verify must pass before any merge (principle 12); the pass must be on the merge result. A merge whose code changes are all process tooling (the listed kit files and their tests) needs only the quick gate (verify-quick-before-merge, D-98); anything in the product, the guards or the gate machinery needs the full gate

verify-quick-before-merge.why: Every merge needs at least tests, lints and build green on the merge result (npm run verify -- --quick records it; a full pass counts)

design-review-before-merge.why: A merge that changes the user interface needs a design review of the built screen at every breakpoint (screenshots, layout audit); set the paths to the product's UI folders

status-refresh-owed.why: Refresh the status page after merges and customer rounds

quality-gate.why: The release gate is decided from the quality scorecard (kit/evaluate.mjs --record): gate met, or an override with a reason

t3-before-plan.why: Close the iteration on the status page before the next Plan

forecast-before-build.why: Build starts only after the Customer Advocate forecast is committed and the specs answer it and name the keep list rows they touch (method/customer-advocate.md)
